description: An oscillator built from three points on a sphere, each turned by its own sine LFO, with the points flattened onto a plane to make the output

params.text: Raises that axis's LFO by whole octaves; set to Off the axis is pinned to 1Hz under the Old dephase algorithm and stops turning altogether under the New one
Sets how far that axis's LFO turns the sphere, none at the far left and its full amount at the far right
Adds a steady turn of that axis on top of whatever its LFO is doing, 0 to 100
Sets how much that axis's flattened position is added to the output, none at the far left and its full amount at the far right
Cycles Mono, where both outputs carry the same signal, Full Stereo, where points near the centre of the sphere are sent to both sides, and Sides, where a point only reaches the side it lies on
Cycles the number of voices the two outputs carry, 1 to 16, each voice a slightly turned copy of the sphere; right-click it to choose a number directly

inputs.text: Sets the frequency of that axis's LFO at 1V per octave
Sets the base rate the three LFOs are scaled from, measured between rising edges and accepted between 0.001Hz and 1000Hz; with nothing patched that base is 2Hz
Adds to that axis's OCTAVE knob at 1V per octave
Adds to that axis's LFO INFLUENCE knob, 1V covering the whole of its travel, and the total is held between 0 and 1
Adds to that axis's ROTATION knob, 1V for each step of its 0 to 100 scale
Adds to that axis's INFLUENCE knob, 1V covering the whole of its travel, and the total is held between 0 and 1

outputs.text: The left side of the flattened sphere, one polyphonic channel per spread voice; in Mono it carries the same signal as the other output
The right side of the flattened sphere, one polyphonic channel per spread voice; in Mono it carries the same signal as the other output

notes: setting all three V/OCT jacks to the same pitch moves the pitch while holding the shape of the rotation you have built
turning one axis moves the other two, so the three never act on their own
the screen draws the path each of the three points has traced, one colour per axis, faded down by that axis's INFLUENCE knob
menu: Projection Axis: X, Y, Z — chooses the plane the three points are flattened onto to make the output
Disable Spread Volume Normalization — stops the output being divided down as the spread count rises, so more voices give a louder sum; once off it reads Enable
Dephase Algorithm: Old, New — Old pulls each LFO back towards zero phase, New drives each towards the phase a free-running oscillator of that frequency would have reached
Sample Rate: Full, Half — Half runs the oscillator on every second sample
Enable Quantization — right-click an OCTAVE knob; makes that knob snap to whole octaves again, and it reads Disable Quantization while snapping is on
